description: Tokenized Asset Purchase: submit a purchase quote for a tokenized asset with its stated terms: optionally the asset with its id, name, ticker and chain; the quote with its id, the price per token, the currency, the tokens the buyer receives, the total, each fee with its label and amount, the spread it states, the NAV or mid price it sits against, its minimum, when it was quoted and when it lapses, what the buyer receives (the token itself, a wrapped token, a claim on the platform, a fund unit or other) and its wording, read for no fees, zero spread, at NAV or price guaranteed; the terms with the price basis (NAV, mid, fixed or market), the most spread they allow, the minimum, the currency, the minutes a quote must stay open and what they promise the buyer receives; and the order with the amount the buyer means to spend and when the buyer would accept. The signed report gives the quote with its fees and the total stated beside the total recomputed from the tokens, the price and every fee, the spread stated beside the spread recomputed from the reference price and the most the terms allow, the expiry with the minutes open and whether it lapses before acceptance, and what the buyer receives beside the terms, and counts them, and names a misleading quote: a total that does not add up, a spread above the one stated or the one allowed, a quote that lapses before acceptance, an order under the minimum, a different instrument delivered and fee-free, spread-free or price-locked wording the figures contradict; then a spread the quote leaves unstated and a minimum, currency or validity that differs from the terms, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No tokens or total, no reference price or spread, no expiry or acceptance time, no instrument and no terms leave the quote unverified. This reads one token purchase quote against its own terms: conversion quotes ranked by effective rate are wever_exchange-quote-check, provider quotes for one job compared are wever_quote-compare and the NAV the Atlas dataset records is wever_atlas-nav-evidence. Verdict tokenized_quote_misleading, tokenized_quote_partial, tokenized_quote_unverified or tokenized_quote_clear. POST /api/tokenized-quote-check. Reads the purchase records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Tokenized Asset Purchase reads the buyer’s own records for one purchase of a tokenized asset and checks each step before money moves: the quote against its stated terms, the platform’s terms against the buyer, the custody arrangement, the redemption path, the transfer restrictions, the settlement, the claimed backing and the full cost. Beside it, wever_atlas-asset-passport and wever_atlas-redemption-check read what the published Tokenization Atlas dataset records about an asset by its id, while a purchase check reads the records the buyer supplies for one purchase; and wever_vendor-quote-check and wever_price-truth-check read quotes and charges for goods, services and paid calls, while the quote and cost checks read a token purchase against its own terms. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/tokenized-purchase-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/tokenized-asset-purchase/.

chain.description: The chain or ledger the token lives on.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

accept_at.description: When the buyer would accept, such as 2026-11-20T15:00:00Z.

amount.description: What the buyer means to spend.

expires_at.description: A date or time, such as 2026-11-20T15:00:00Z.

quoted_at.description: A date or time, such as 2026-11-20T15:00:00Z.

reference_price.description: The NAV or mid price the quote sits against.

text.description: Read for wording such as no fees, zero spread, at NAV or price guaranteed.

valid_minutes.description: Minutes a quote must stay open.

name: wever_tokenized-quote-check
title: Tokenized quote check
